narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The middle counts are four and nine, so the median is six point five.
<bookmark mark='why'/>Four and nine tell how many students, not how many throws. Counts of students cannot be a number of throws.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The median must be a number of throws. The bubble is wrong.
